App details

Tuner & Metronome

Tune an instrument and keep time while practising with a tuner and metronome.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Chromatic tuner with note, frequency and cents plus reference tone; metronome with 20–400 BPM, saved tempos, subdivisions and background playback.

Main features

  • See the note, frequency and tuning difference.
  • Adjust the reference pitch or play a reference tone.
  • Set tempo, beats and subdivisions.
  • Save tempos and run the metronome in the background.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Tune a note and practise a rhythm

Chromatic tuning

Allow microphone access, choose an available input and play a note. See frequency, note name, octave and deviation in cents, where 100 cents make a semitone. Noisy or uncertain input is marked rather than showing a falsely steady note; device and microphone affect response.

Reference pitch and tuning tolerance

Set A4 between 400 and 480 Hz, normally 440 Hz. Choose precise ±2, normal ±5 or relaxed ±10 cent feedback; the displayed deviation remains unchanged. Select a note and octave to play its reference tone explicitly, using the same A4 reference.

Metronome and Tap Tempo

Set a tempo from 20 to 400 beats per minute and start the metronome. Tap Tempo estimates BPM after two or three taps and refines it with more. A long pause starts a new tapping estimate. The displayed beat helps follow the pulse while the metronome maintains its timing.

Time signatures, subdivisions and cues

Choose 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 or 6/8, or a custom numerator 1–16 with denominator 2, 4, 8 or 16. Add an optional first-beat accent and quarter, eighth, triplet or sixteenth subdivisions. Choose click, wood, beep or cowbell-like sound, visual beat and optional vibration. Unsupported extreme combinations are identified.

Presets and background practice

Use classical tempo names or save your own name, BPM, time signature and accent/subdivision. Load, edit or delete presets; loading does not start sound by itself. An explicitly started metronome can continue screen-off/background with notification Stop and supported Pause/Resume controls. Presets are saved, not a practice history.

Runaway metronome

Tap the About logo seven times for a drawn metronome that speeds up until its pendulum flies off. This short offline joke is simulated and does not start an unsafe real click sequence or change your presets.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
